mapper.update: UPDATE cms_claim_request SET status = #{targetStatus}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, review_comment = #{comment}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND version = #{version}

UPDATE cms_claim_request SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancel_reason = #{reason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED') AND version = #{version}
